subject: AcreetionOS Update — June 19, 2026
body:
The AcreetionOS continuous integration pipeline has just been fine-tuned again, building on the recent introduction of per-pipeline staging directories and relative symlinks for the latest ISO images, which significantly boosts the reliability and efficiency of our release process. This change is now reflected in our changelog page at https://acreetionos.org/changelog.html, where you can find detailed information about the latest developments in our project.

Development 
The development team has been hard at work, making sure our ISO build pipeline is robust and efficient. With the latest changes to the pipeline, we're seeing improved reliability and faster release times. You can learn more about our development process and how to get involved on our wiki page at https://acreetionos.org/wiki.html.

Community 
The community has been active, with discussions around the latest Emacs release and security updates. We're proud to be part of a community that values privacy and security, and we're committed to providing a secure and reliable operating system. For more information on our security practices and how to stay up-to-date with the latest security updates, visit our documentation page at https://acreetionos.org/docs.html. 

Tip of the day 
If you're looking for the latest ISO image, you can find it on our website at https://acreetionos.org/flash.html. We're always working to improve our release process, and we appreciate your feedback and support.
